notes: Per trace-domain row of the evaluation domain; nodes are distinct subexpressions after hash-consing and exact folding (x+0, x*1, x*0, x-x, literal folding); dead nodes removed.
base = M31 values (mask reads, integer literals); secure = extension values (FS challenges, claims, publics are invocation parameters).
m31_mul_equiv_per_row counts expression products plus the composition fold (power x residual) plus the vanishing-inverse scale: base*base=1, base*secure=degree, secure*secure=9 (QM31) / 27 (OM31).
requested_lane_ops = arithmetic lane calls the native emitter makes before folding/CSE (an upper bound on unoptimised per-row work).
